text: Follow-up CT Chest after 8 weeks of osimertinib therapy. COMPARISON: CT chest dated 06/18/2024. FINDINGS: Significant interval decrease in size of the right lower lobe mass, now measuring 2.1 cm (previously 3.5 cm), representing approximately 40% reduction. Decreased size of right paratracheal lymphadenopathy, now 1.2 cm (previously 2.1 cm). No new lesions. No pleural effusion. IMPRESSION: Partial response to targeted therapy. RECIST criteria: Partial response (PR). Recommend continued systemic therapy with reassessment in 8-12 weeks.
